en: Vintage sepia postcard showing the waterfront and harbor of a coastal town, with small sailing boats moored along a quay, low hills in the background, and a few people and carts on the promenade. Printed Greek and French text at the top identifies the location as the quay of Argostoli and Venizelos Street. There is a handwritten signature or note across the upper center. The bottom right bears the website watermark 'www.elia.org.gr'.
